availableCommands.name: goal
availableCommands.description: Autonomous roadmap driver. Use whenever the user wants Claude to proceed on its own through a project roadmap item, milestone, or vertical slice until it actually works and is independently verified — not just a single step. Triggered by /goal, and by phrases like "knock out the next roadmap item", "drive this to done", "proceed until the capstone passes", "keep going until X works", "autopilot this milestone", "take it to green", "finish the slice". Invoke it even when the user doesn't say "goal" but clearly wants sustained, self-directed progress toward a verifiable done-state (resolve target → ensure a plan + acceptance gate → implement TDD, committing each step → verify against real behavior → loop until green or genuinely blocked). Invoking this skill authorizes multi-agent orchestration (Workflow and parallel agents) for the duration of the goal. (user)
